fields.label: Prompt
fields.name: prompt
fields.tooltip: What the body DOES — verb-first, one continuous action per segment. Multi-segment: separate with | and pair with motion_prompts.

fields.label: Seed
fields.name: seed
fields.tooltip: Same seed + prompt = same motion take.

fields.label: Duration (s)
fields.name: duration_sec
fields.tooltip: Length of the generated motion segment.

fields.label: Diffusion steps
fields.name: diffusion_steps
fields.tooltip: More steps = smoother arcs; 25 is the calibrated default.

fields.label: Samples
fields.name: num_samples
fields.tooltip: Takes per prompt (each becomes its own NPZ).

fields.label: Transition frames
fields.name: num_transition_frames
fields.tooltip: Blend frames when chaining onto a previous motion (motion_npz).

fields.label: CFG mode
fields.name: cfg_type
fields.tooltip: separated = independent text/action guidance (calibrated); nocfg = fastest.

fields.label: CFG weight A
fields.name: cfg_weight_a
fields.tooltip: Text guidance weight (separated mode).

fields.label: CFG weight B
fields.name: cfg_weight_b
fields.tooltip: Action guidance weight (separated mode).

fields.label: Chain from NPZ
fields.name: motion_npz
fields.tooltip: Previous motion NPZ to continue — the new prompt takes over after num_transition_frames of blend.

fields.label: Multi-segment prompts
fields.name: motion_prompts
fields.tooltip: Segment prompts joined with | — one motion per segment, auto-chained in order.

fields.label: Joint constraints
fields.name: motion_constraints
fields.tooltip: Pin joints (e.g. left_foot:ground) — JSON or key:value lines, applied per segment.
